text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
It's well past sunset, so I decide to<n>escort Rice
Shower home after a day<n>out.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Big Brother... Can you do something<n>for me?

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Big Sister... Can you do something for<n>me?

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
I was wondering if you could wait in<n>your office for
a little bit...

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: I have something I want to show you.
choice_data_list: Sure.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: I have something I want to show you.
choice_data_list: Sure.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Th-thank you! I'll be there really<n>soon, so just hold
on!

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
While I wait for her, I make us both a<n>cup of tea and
wonder what she<n>could possibly want to show me.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Sorry for the wait.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Sorry for the wait.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: This is what I wanted to show you.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text: She holds out a book to me.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text: The black cover reads The Sun andthe Child of Shadow.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
This is... a picture book that I made.<n>I'd like you to
read it.
choice_data_list: Is it okay if I read it now?

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
This is... a picture book that I made.<n>I'd like you to
read it.
choice_data_list: Is it okay if I read it now?

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Sure.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text: She smiles as I open it.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
It doesn't have any text. It starts with<n>pure
darkness.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
There's something crouching in that<n>darkness. A
silhouette... that kind of<n>looks like Rice Shower.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
The shadowy figure is crying in the<n>darkness. She
looks so sad and<n>lonely.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
Suddenly, a small light appears in the<n>darkness, and
the little shadow<n>begins to walk toward the light.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
As she continues walking, the light<n>grows stronger
and stronger. It grows<n>radiant, until finally...

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
The light turns into the sun. The<n>darkness is
dispelled, and the world<n>is illuminated.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
The sun's warm light washes over<n>the shadowy
figure, revealing her true<n>form.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
On the final page, the girl, once<n>consumed by
shadows, is now<n>prancing around joyfully in the
world<n>of light.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
...I wanted to show this book to you<n>before anyone
else.
choice_data_list: I'm honored.
I'm honored.
I'm sure it will make people very happy.
I want to be like that sun.
I want to be like that sun.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
...I wanted to show this book to you<n>before anyone
else.
choice_data_list: I'm honored.
I'm honored.
I'm sure it will make people very happy.
I want to be like that sun.
I want to be like that sun.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
You've always been the closest to<n>me, watching
over me with warmth<n>and kindness.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: That's why... I wanted to show you...

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: That's why... I wanted to show you...

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: My precious, precious... happiness.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Big Brother...

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Big Sister...

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Please watch over me... forever and<n>ever.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
I nod with so much enthusiasm that<n>she ends up
laughing at me.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Hehehe, I hope so.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
That book is the embodiment of my<n>happiness,
after all.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: And it sounds like my feelings got<n>across to you.
choice_data_list:
Now you can spread your happiness to even more
people.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: And it sounds like my feelings got<n>across to you.
choice_data_list:
Now you can spread your happiness to even more
people.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Right!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Big Brother, I... I want everyone who<n>supports me
to be happy.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Big Sister, I... I want everyone who<n>supports me to
be happy.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Since I made that book, this<n>feeling—this wish—has
become even<n>stronger within me.
choice_data_list: Then you can count on me to help make it happen.
Then you can count on me to help make it happen.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Yeah. With your help, I'm sure...

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Yeah. With your help, I'm sure...

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
As Rice Shower trails off with a smile<n>on her face, I
make a silent vow to<n>myself that I will see her wish
come<n>true, no matter what.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Big Brother... You've always been...

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Big Sister... You've always been...

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: My sun.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Because of your support and faith in<n>me...

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Because of your support and faith in<n>me...

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: I've been able to change, little by<n>little...

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
So I took the happiness you've given<n>me and made
it into this book.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: ...Thank you for everything.
choice_data_list: Now it's your turn to become the sun.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: ...Thank you for everything.
choice_data_list: Now it's your turn to become the sun.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: I... can be the sun?

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: I... want to try.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: I want to shine... and bring happiness<n>to everyone.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: I want to be their sun!
choice_data_list: Let's make that dream a reality.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Yeah!

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
For a moment, Rice Shower's eyes<n>shine like the
sun, as if a bright dream<n>has settled within them.
